posts.title: Who Is Awakening?
posts.description: We must be totally and utterly honest within ourselves. There is nobody there. Nobody is awakening. If someone is, then that someone is really fortifying his castle of sleep. posts.title: The Temple of the Present Moment
posts.description: The incomplete life is a constant search for the Temple. Externalised, that becomes a search for a system, a religion, a society, a book, a film, piece of music. This incessant movement, the “search”, becomes an inner incompleteness and a subtle, low-level, incessant dissatisfaction. We finish one book, and we are in the search for another. […]

posts.title: Radical Zero
posts.description: Our life is a succession of infinite present moments. It is never made out of anything else. We have to reflect on that deeply. Life is never made from anything else!
